subject: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — capacity surge/runbook
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsprint.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@medsprint.com>
Cc: procurement@medsprint.com
Date: 2027-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — capacity surge/runbook

Hi Elena / Kevin —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. MedSprint’s renewal is coming up in late May, and you indicated a hard requirement that patient data for EU contracts remain resident in EU sovereign regions. At the same time you want APAC proximity for new clinician-facing features later this year and a short-term surge window for an expected product launch in Q3.

Attached is a first-pass renewal SOW (medsprint_sow_v2.pdf) and a pricing spreadsheet with three options (pricing-options.xlsx). High-level proposal:
- Add an EU Data Residency addendum (pinning compute + persistent logs to EU region)
- APAC onramp as an add-on: staged burst capacity with pilot region in APAC-SG for low-latency routing
- Cross-region failover: automatic read-only fallback to secondary region (metadata & read requests only) with documented escalation to allow full payload replay only under customer-approved playbook

Can we schedule a 45-minute renewal + runbook sync next week? I’m proposing Thu 4/15 or Fri 4/16 morning PST.

Next steps from our side: draft EU onramp runbook and canary schedule, list of data residency controls, and updated SLA/price options. Please confirm internal stakeholders for procurement and security so we loop them into the DocuSign amendment.

Attachments: medsprint_sow_v2.pdf (application/pdf), pricing-options.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsprint.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@medsprint.com>, procurement@medsprint.com
Date: 2027-04-08T13:55:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — capacity surge/runbook

Sean —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. A few clarifying items up front before we lock time:
1) EU residency: for our EU customers this must include (a) compute + persistent store in EU, (b) keys managed in customer-controlled KMS (we can provide AWS KMS), and (c) audit logs retained in-region for 7 years.
2) Failover behavior: we cannot have any non-EU copy of PHI unless explicitly triggered for disaster recovery and with written approval. Metadata-only failover is acceptable for service continuity but we need the exact definition of what counts as metadata.
3) APAC rollout: timing is flexible but we need 99th pct latency targets for the clinician UX; can you provide expected latency from APAC-SG?
4) Procurement: our legal wants the amendment to include the residency addendum and pricing floor. Please include a single consolidated DocuSign link.

If we can get clear answers to 1–3 I’ll put procurement on a short list for the 4/15 slot.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Head of IT Ops, MedSprint Health
elena.torres@medsprint.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — action items (MedSprint)

Team — forwarding Elena’s note from MedSprint. Quick notes and asks (we need this turned around by EOD Tue so I can confirm 4/15):

Quoted below.

My read: we can satisfy 1–3 but need ops validation on the exact failover semantics and a KMS integration note for customer-managed keys. Proposed approach:
- EU residency addendum: pin inference GPU, persistent logs, and audit indices to eu-west-1. Customer KMS supported via external-key config (requires 1-week lead time for key exchange + IAM trust).
- Failover policy: propose "metadata-only" = request headers, routing keys, model selection, and cached embeddings allowed in secondary region. No raw transcripts or persistent logs leave EU unless a signed DR trigger document is submitted and countersigned by both parties.
- APAC latency: estimate (APAC-SG -> APAC-SG region): p99 generation latency ~ 120–180ms for current model family at pilot scale (10 concurrent clinician sessions), burst can hit 3x baseline with Dedicated burst pool. Need Karthik/Vivek to confirm numbers for a 100-rps surge scenario.

Action items:
1) Vivek/Karthik: technical confirmation + runbook for EU failover semantics + latency numbers for APAC pilot (include resource footprint).
2) Marissa/Rachel: prepare 3 pricing options (baseline renewal with residency addendum, add-on APAC pilot, and premium dedicated burst with SLA uplift) and a draft DocuSign amendment.
3) Sean: schedule the 4/15 call if we can get the pricing & runbook by Tue.

Attachments to include in drive link: eu-onramp-runbook-draft.pdf (internal), pricing-options.xlsx (internal).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.
Sean

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — action items (MedSprint)

All —

Summary / proposed customer-facing language and deliverables. I’m dropping this here so Sean can send back to Elena with a single clear proposal. Please comment inline in the Drive link if any technical points need changing.

Customer-facing summary (short):
- EU Data Residency Addendum: Redwood will keep all inference compute, persistent logs, and audit indices within eu-west-1 for any MedSprint accounts flagged as EU-resident. Customer-managed KMS integration supported; we will exchange required IAM principals after amendment execution.
- Cross-region Failover (Operational): Failover to secondary region will be metadata-only by default (defined as request/response headers, request routing context, model version pointers, and cached KV prefixes). No raw prompt/response transcripts or persistent logs will leave EU without a documented and signed DR trigger.
- APAC Onramp Pilot: 4-week pilot in APAC-SG. Goal: p99 latency below 200ms for clinician workflows at up to 100 simultaneous sessions. Initial pilot uses a burst pool; premium option includes Dedicated reserved capacity.

Deliverables we will provide with amendment:
1) EU Onramp runbook (attached: eu-onramp-runbook-draft.pdf) — includes canary steps, rollback plan, verification script outputs, and audit retention details.
2) Pricing options (attached: pricing-options.xlsx) — three tiers (Renewal + residency; Residency + APAC pilot; Residency + Dedicated burst with SLA uplift).
3) Draft DocuSign amendment (I’ll put the link in the Drive once legal signs off).

Vivek/Karthik — please confirm that the runbook wording on metadata-only failover matches the product semantics. Specifically: cached embeddings and KV prefixes are allowed to be used in the secondary region for latency-sensitive read operations; raw prompts and full user transcripts are not replicated. If you need different wording we should update the template now.

Rachel — can you draft the DocuSign envelope and include the new residency addendum + APAC pilot SOW as attachments (medsprint_sow_v2.pdf + eu-onramp-runbook-draft.pdf + pricing-options.xlsx)? I’ll review before we send.

If no redlines from tech/legal by Tue EOD, Sean — book Thu 4/15 9:00–9:45am PST for the renewal run-through and include procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Director — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: eu-onramp-runbook-draft.pdf (internal), pricing-options.xlsx (internal)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsprint.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@medsprint.com>
Cc: procurement@medsprint.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency & APAC onramp — capacity surge/runbook

Elena / Kevin —

Thanks for the questions earlier — copying Marissa, Vivek, Rachel, and Karthik so you have the operational owners on the thread. To confirm the items you flagged and propose the immediate path forward: 

1) EU residency requirements — confirmed: compute + persistent logs + audit indices will be pinned to eu-west-1 for EU-designated accounts. We will support customer-managed KMS (we’ll coordinate an IAM principal exchange after amendment). Audit retention in-region is supported and we will add explicit 7-year retention language to the addendum.

2) Failover semantics — final proposed wording: "Metadata-only failover" = request routing context, headers, model selection pointers, and cached KV/embedding prefixes allowed to be used in the secondary region for read/serve operations. No raw prompts, responses, or persistent logs are replicated out of EU except under a documented, countersigned Disaster Recovery trigger (DR Trigger) that grants temporary, scoped export rights. We will add that DR Trigger template to the runbook.

3) APAC onramp latency & capacity — initial estimates for APAC-SG pilot: p99 gen latency 120–180ms at pilot scale (10 concurrent clinician sessions). For the 100 concurrent sessions surge target, we recommend the Dedicated burst pool (pricing-option C) which achieves p99 under 200ms based on internal load tests. Karthik and Vivek are copy for detailed throughput numbers and the runbook.

Next steps / timeline we propose: 
- By Tue 4/13 EOD: internal sign-off on runbook wording + pricing.
- Wed 4/14: Rachel will publish DocuSign envelope for the amendment (residency addendum + SOW + pricing).
- Thu 4/15 09:00–09:45 PST: Renewal + technical run-through (proposed) — please confirm if this time works for your procurement and security leads.
- 4-week APAC pilot (start date to be scheduled post-amendment execution).

DocuSign / Drive: https://docusign.com/rooms/xyz-Medsprint-amendment (will be live Wed), runbook draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRunbookDraft

If that all looks good I’ll lock the Thu slot and Rachel will send the envelope. Appreciate the quick alignment — we’ll treat this as a priority renewal.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachments: medsprint_sow_v2.pdf, eu-onramp-runbook-draft.pdf, pricing-options.xlsx
